mapper.sql: FROM dm_target_table_field f JOIN dm_target_table t ON t.table_code=f.table_code AND t.tenant_id=f.tenant_id AND t.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON p.id=t.project_id AND p.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN dm_component dc ON dc.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND dc.project_id=t.project_id AND dc.system_code=t.system_code LEFT JOIN arch_physical_subsystem ps ON ps.tenant_id=dc.tenant_id AND ps.code=dc.system_code AND ps.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=t.owner_id AND u.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND u.deleted=0

f.field_code, f.field_name_en, f.field_name_cn, f.field_meaning, f.code_description, f.is_key_field, f.oracle_type, f.mysql_type, f.is_nullable, f.is_primary_key, f.dict_code, t.table_code, t.project_id, t.system_code, t.table_name_en, t.table_name_cn, t.table_meaning, t.owner_id, t.created_at, t.updated_at, p.project_name, ps.business_group_name AS business_group, ps.name AS system_name, u.display_name AS owner_name

WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND f.deleted=0 AND t.table_category=#{category} AND t.project_id=#{projectId} AND t.system_code=#{p.systemCode} AND f.is_key_field=#{p.isKeyField} AND f.dict_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.dictCode},'%') AND (t.table_name_en LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.tableKeyword},'%') OR t.table_name_cn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.tableKeyword},'%')) AND (f.field_name_en LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.fieldKeyword},'%') OR f.field_name_cn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.fieldKeyword},'%'))
